0.0: You look a lot better since I last saw you. Glad to see it, #b#ho##k. Hey, I have something for you. It's made from some pretty powerful materials, and it should enhance your own power if you carry it with you.

no.0: Well, talk to me again if you decide you want it.

yes.0: I'll be by your side, #b#ho##k, until the day you fully recover your powers. You've got nothing to worry about, so follow whichever path you choose.
